Every control in the app's Settings window (⌘, or **Settings…** in the menu), with its default. Each one is
stored in the app's UserDefaults domain under its key: `defaults read io.github.altoption.ai-task-tracking <key>`.

## General

| Setting | Default | Key |
|---|---|---|
| Launch at login | — (the app's macOS login item, not a UserDefaults key) | — |
| Show in the Dock | on | `showInDock` |
| Show Needs-you issues in the menu | on | `showNeedsYouInMenu` |
| Show stalled work in Needs you | on | `showStalledInNeedsYou` |
| Show CI status | on | `showCIStatus` |

## Appearance

| Setting | Default | Key |
|---|---|---|
| Theme | Dark (also Light, Match macOS, Midnight, Paper, High contrast and your theme files; saved as `theme` in config.yml) | `theme` |

## Hidden projects

| Setting | Default | Key |
|---|---|---|
| Hidden projects | none (one checkbox per project, and No project; saved as `hiddenProjects` in config.yml) | `hiddenProjects` |

## Notifications

| Setting | Default | Key |
|---|---|---|
| Notify me about agent activity | on | `notifications` |
| An agent needs me (Waiting, Needs decision/review, stalled) | on | `notifyNeedsYou` |
| An agent finished an issue (Done) | on | `notifyDone` |
| An agent created an issue | off | `notifyNew` |

## Shortcuts

| Setting | Default | Key |
|---|---|---|
| Open AI Task Tracking window | on | `openWindowHotKey` |
| Open AI Task Tracking window: shortcut | ⌥⌘I (also ⌃⌥⌘I, ⌥⌘T) | `openWindowHotKeyPreset` |
| Quick capture | on | `quickCaptureHotKey` |
| Quick capture: shortcut | ⌥⌘N (also ⌃⌥⌘N, ⌥⇧⌘N) | `quickCaptureHotKeyPreset` |

## Backup

| Setting | Default | Key |
|---|---|---|
| Back up to GitHub before quitting | on | `backupBeforeQuit` |
